content.text:
This is an unrelated flaky timeout, not a failure in PR #13182’s dotfiles changes.

- `mise run test:unit-ci` ran 4,053 tests; 4,052 passed.
- `mise_binary_services_aube_node_gyp_bootstrap_trampoline` exceeded exactly 1 second and nextest terminated it at 1.012s.
- The [nextest configuration](https://github.com/jdx/mise/blob/main/.config/nextest.toml) sets `250ms × 4`, producing that 1-second ceiling.
- This test launches the complete mise binary and bootstraps aube’s `node-gyp`, so its runtime varies. Recent successful main runs took 0.784s and 0.965s—already very close to the cutoff.
- More decisively, the identical test also timed out on earlier main-branch runs at 1.013s and 1.016s, before this PR.

A rerun will probably pass. The durable fix is to give [this binary-level test](https://github.com/jdx/mise/blob/main/tests/aube_node_gyp_bootstrap.rs) a larger nextest timeout, similar to the existing CLI-graph override.
